characters.name: Malenia, Blade of Miquella
characters.description: Goddess of Rot, undefeated warrior, twin of Miquella, Scarlet Aeonia.

characters.name: Starscourge Radahn
characters.description: Conqueror of the Stars, gravity magic, Redmane Castle lord.

characters.name: Godrick the Grafted
characters.description: First Shardbearer, grafts limbs onto himself, Stormveil Castle lord.

characters.name: Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy
characters.description: Devoured by the Serpent, Volcano Manor lord, Rykard's Rancor.

characters.name: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon
characters.description: Carian Queen, Full Moon sorcery, Academy of Raya Lucaria head.

characters.name: Mohg, Lord of Blood
characters.description: Bloodflame, Mohgwyn Palace, seeks to raise Miquella as god.

characters.name: Morgott, the Omen King
characters.description: Leyndell's last king, cursed blood, guards the Erdtree.

characters.name: Miquella of the Haligtree
characters.description: Eternal child, Haligtree creator, twin of Malenia, Unalloyed Gold Needle.

characters.name: Radagon of the Golden Order
characters.description: Marika's consort, Elden Beast host, hammer of Marika.

characters.name: Marika the Eternal
characters.description: Elden Ring vessel, shattered the Ring, mother of demigods.

characters.name: Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing
characters.description: Roundtable Hold leader, knows all, uses copied incantations.

characters.name: Fia, Deathbed Companion
characters.description: Deathbed Smother, Mending Rune of Death-Prince, Godwyn's companion.

characters.name: Rya
characters.description: Volcano Manor guest, serpent-girl, seeks her true self.

characters.name: Rogier
characters.description: Sorcerer, Roundtable Hold, Fia's champion, dies from thorns.

characters.name: D, Hunter of the Dead
characters.description: Twinblade wielder, hunts Those Who Live in Death.

characters.name: Nepheli Loux
characters.description: Warrior, Gideon's adopted daughter, potential Leyndell lord.

characters.name: Kenneth Haight
characters.description: Fort Haight lord, seeks to reclaim Fort Faroth.

characters.name: Jarren
characters.description: Rogier's friend, Roundtable Hold, cares for Nepheli.

characters.name: Boc the Seamster
characters.description: Demi-human tailor, seeks to become 'proper' human.

characters.name: Patches
characters.description: Trickster, kicks you into pits, recurring Souls character.

characters.name: Iron Fist Alexander
characters.description: Living jar warrior, seeks to become a great warrior.

characters.name: Jar-Bairn
characters.description: Jar village elder, Alexander's mentor.

characters.name: Millicent
characters.description: Rot-infected maiden, Malenia's descendant, Unalloyed Gold Needle.

characters.name: Gowry
characters.description: Millicent's caretaker, sage of the Swamp of Aeonia.

characters.name: Tanith
characters.description: Volcano Manor consort, Rykard's wife, Recusant leader.

synergies.name: Path to Elden Lord
synergies.description: Key figures on the journey to become Elden Lord
